feas.roofs_vs_space: {roof_m2} m² of cool roof needed; about {capacity_m2} m² of roof looks usable.

why.cool_roof: {roof_m2} m² of white or reflective roof cools the block in the first summer.
why.shade_structure: {shade} shade sails or canopies over the hottest lanes and stops.
why.awareness: Talk to neighbours, schools and shops so more people join and care for the trees.

air.enjoy_outdoors: Air is clean: a good time to be outside.
air.ventilate: Open the windows to air out your home.
air.sensitive_watch: Very sensitive people should watch for coughing or shortness of breath.
air.ventilate_off_peak: Air out your home in the early morning or late evening.
air.sensitive_reduce: Children, older people and anyone with asthma or heart disease should cut long or hard outdoor activity.
air.windows_peak: Keep windows closed during rush hours.
air.mask_sensitive: Sensitive people should wear a well-fitted N95 or KN95 mask outside.
air.reduce_outdoor: Everyone should cut long or hard outdoor activity.
air.mask_n95: Wear a well-fitted N95 or KN95 mask outside.
air.avoid_outdoor: Avoid outdoor exercise; move activities indoors.
air.purifier: Run an air purifier or fan with a filter if you have one.
air.stay_indoors: Stay indoors as much as possible; seek medical help if you feel unwell.

haor_flood.title: Haor flash flood risk
haor_flood.body: Up to {local_mm} mm locally and {up_mm} mm upstream in Meghalaya over 3 days. Hill water can enter the haor within 24–48 h.
haor_flood.a1: Harvest Boro immediately if 80% of grains are mature.
haor_flood.a2: Move harvested paddy, seed and livestock to high ground.
haor_flood.a3: Check embankments (bãdh) with your neighbours and report breaches to the Upazila office.

rice_heat.title: Heat stress at flowering
rice_heat.body: {days} day(s) at or above 35 °C from {day} (peak {peak} °C). Pollen dies above 35 °C, causing empty grains (chita).
rice_heat.a1: Keep 5–7 cm of standing water in the field during flowering.
rice_heat.a2: Irrigate in the afternoon to cool the canopy.
rice_heat.a3: Avoid spraying pesticides between 10 am and 2 pm.

drought.title: Dry spell / drought risk
drought.body: Only {rain30} mm of rain in the past 30 days (NASA POWER) and {rain7} mm forecast this week, while crops lose ~{et7} mm to evaporation.
drought.a1: Use alternate wetting and drying (AWD) to stretch irrigation water.
drought.a2: Mulch vegetable beds with straw to keep moisture.
drought.a3: Plan supplementary irrigation for transplanted Aman if rain stays low.

storm.title: Storm / nor’wester risk
storm.body: Wind gusts up to {gust} km/h expected from {day}.
storm.a1_harvest: Harvest mature crops before the storm arrives.
storm.a1_stake: Stake banana, papaya and tall vegetables.
storm.a2: Store seed and harvested grain in sealed bags on raised platforms.
storm.a3: Follow BMD signals and move to a cyclone shelter if told to evacuate.

cold.a1: Cover Boro seedbeds with clear polythene at night, open during the day.
cold.a2: Keep 2–3 cm water in seedbeds and drain cold water in the morning.
cold.a3: Protect livestock with jute sacks and dry bedding.

late_blight.title: Late blight weather
late_blight.body: Cool, foggy and humid conditions for {days} days: ideal for late blight (Phytophthora) on potato and tomato.
late_blight.a1: Ask your local agriculture officer (DAE) which preventive fungicide to use and how much.
late_blight.a3: Remove and destroy infected plants immediately.

monsoon.title: Monsoon onset likely
monsoon.body: Three or more consecutive rainy days expected around {day}.
monsoon.a1: Prepare Aman seedbeds on raised land.
monsoon.a3: Good time to plant trees: survival is highest now.

lightning.title: Lightning risk
lightning.body: Atmosphere is highly unstable (CAPE up to {cape} J/kg) with thunderstorms likely from {day} {time}.
lightning.a1: Leave open fields when dark clouds gather, usually in the afternoon.
lightning.a2: Do not shelter under isolated trees; crouch low with feet together if caught outside.
lightning.a3: Avoid ponds, canals and metal tools during storms.

worker_heat.title: Dangerous heat for field work
worker_heat.a1: Work early morning and late afternoon.
worker_heat.a2: Drink water with ORS every 20 minutes.
worker_heat.a3: Rest in shade; watch for dizziness and stop work if unwell.

canned.tree: Young trees need deep watering twice a week in hot, dry weather, a mulch ring around the base and a guard. Add a photo every 15 days so we can check their health.
